title: fix(app-shell): judge the package version with the installed spec's field schema (objectui#10207)
body:
Closes #10207

Clause-②: no. On the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 the dialog accepts and refuses exactly what it did before (measured below). After a spec release that carries objectstack#18697, the dialog follows the contract automatically. That corrects it to match the contract; it adds no new surface.

⏹ The card body's `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#18697` line is void. It is a cycle: objectstack#18697 waits for this card. See triage comment 5817640535. This PR does not edit the card body. Striking that line is left to the seat.

## What changed

- `PackageFormDialog.tsx`: removed the hand-copied `VERSION_RE = /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/`. `versionOk` now asks `ManifestSchema.shape.version.safeParse(v).success` through a module-private `isSpecPackageVersion`. The `createMode` and edit semantics are unchanged. Create requires a version the spec accepts. Edit allows an empty version, because it is not resubmitted, or a version the spec accepts. The value is still trimmed before it is judged, as before.
- Why the field schema instead of a pattern constant: spec 17.4.0 exports no version-pattern constant. The only matching export from `@objectstack/spec/kernel` is `PROTOCOL_VERSION`; `MAJOR_MINOR_PATCH_VERSION_PATTERN` and the `SEMVER_*` names are absent from the installed `dist/`. objectstack PR #19637 retires the phase-1 constants without aliasing them. Only the field schema itself survives both the rename and the retirement.
- `PackageFormDialog.helpTextI18n.test.tsx`: the en case now reads the expected English from `ManifestSchema.shape.{name,id,version}.description`. Before, it restated the text (`'Package version (semantic versioning)'` and two siblings). The test also asserts that each description is a non-empty string. The zh case's two negative `queryByText` checks read from the schema too, so they cannot become vacuous when the upstream wording changes. The test still proves that the English is rendered from the schema. See ablation C.
- New pin `PackageFormDialog.versionCanon.test.tsx`: over 12 samples, in both create and edit mode, the dialog accepts a sample if and only if `ManifestSchema.shape.version` accepts it. The samples are `1.2.3`, `0.1.0`, `10.20.30`, `01.1.1`, `1.2`, `v1.2.3`, `1.2.3.4`, `latest`, `2.0.0-beta.1`, `1.0.0+build`, `1.0.0-rc.1+exp.sha.5114f85` and `1.0.0-Beta.1`. There is also a non-vacuity check that the spec accepts some samples and refuses others. It also has fixed floors that hold on both 17.4.0 and the SemVer 2.0.0 canon: `1.2.3` is accepted, `1.2`, `v1.2.3` and `1.2.3.4` are refused, and create refuses an empty version while edit allows one. The prerelease and build samples have no verdict written into the test. The installed spec decides them.
- `package-schema.ts`: **no change needed**. It projects `ManifestSchema` through `z.toJSONSchema`, and the help text reaches the form row from that projection's `description`. `SchemaForm` does not read the JSONSchema `pattern`. A repo-wide `git grep` for a three-numeric-segment regex in non-test `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` finds only the removed `VERSION_RE`, so objectui has no other copy of the grammar.
- `.changeset/10207-package-version-from-spec.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` **patch**. No published behaviour changes on 17.4.0.

## No accept-set change on 17.4.0: measured

A direct probe compared `ManifestSchema.shape.version.safeParse` with the old regex on `1.2.3`, `1.2`, `v1.2.3`, `1.2.3.4`, `2.0.0-beta.1`, `1.0.0+build`, the empty string, `0.0.0`, `01.1.1`, a leading or trailing space, `10.20.30` and a trailing newline. Every sample got the same verdict from both. The installed describe string is still `Package version (semantic versioning)`.

## Reverse verification

The fix was committed before the ablations ran. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in the sibling objectstack checkout, with the anchor hit counted and blob hashes checked. Each restore was proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The tests import source files directly, so no build was involved.

- **A: restore the hand-copied regex** in `isSpecPackageVersion`. Result: `Tests 31 passed (31)`, **green, as expected**. The 17.4.0 grammar equals the old regex on every sample, which is this card's "no behaviour change" claim, measured. Because of that, A could not redden anything, so the dispatch's fallback ablation was used next.
- **B: swap in a different grammar**, the permissive `PluginSchema`-shaped one, `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)?(\+[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)?$`. Result: `Tests 8 failed | 23 passed (31)`. The failures are `2.0.0-beta.1`, `1.0.0+build`, `1.0.0-rc.1+exp.sha.5114f85` and `1.0.0-Beta.1`, each in both create and edit mode. This is the mirror image of what the old regex would do once the installed spec adopts SemVer 2.0.0: the dialog and the spec disagree, and the equality pin goes red.
- **C: add a drifted en copy of the help text**, `engine.packages.form.help.version` set to `Package version`. Result: `keeps ONE producer for the English` failed with `Unable to find an element with the text: Package version (semantic versioning)`. The first attempt at C was a refused no-op: the replacement contained the anchor, `ablation-replace` said so, and nothing was mutated. It was rerun with a non-overlapping replacement, and that run is the result quoted here.

## Gates (final head 458565dcb, after merging origin/main)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (the dependency closure, 29 of 47 projects): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFiles` on the test tsconfig includes both edited test files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog`: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 67 passed (67)`.
- `eslint` on the three changed TS/TSX files: 0 errors, 2 warnings. Both warnings are on lines this PR does not touch: `set-state-in-effect` at the create-mode prefill, and `no-explicit-any`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: ✅ 1 changeset declared.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.

## Unlock for objectstack

objectstack#18697's unlock criterion is that this card lands **and** objectstack's `.objectui-sha` covers the landing commit. Once this PR merges and objectstack bumps `.objectui-sha` past it, objectstack PR #19637 can merge. The Console Pin Gate on objectstack `main` then builds an objectui whose dialog and help-text test read the new canon, instead of the old verbatim string.

## Acceptance notes

- The zh help text `软件包版本（语义化版本号）。` is this repo's own translation, so it stays hand-written. After the upstream describe string gains SemVer 2.0.0 examples, the zh line will be a little less specific than the en line. It stays correct. This PR records the difference and does not change it.
